mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.receive_no, r.apply_emp_id, r.dept_id, r.receive_date, r.receive_reason, r.create_time, r.operator_code, r.update_time, COALESCE(e1.emp_name, '') AS apply_emp_name, COALESCE(e1.emp_code, '') AS apply_emp_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e2.emp_name, '') AS operator_name FROM asset_receive_main r LEFT JOIN sys_emp e1 ON r.apply_emp_id = CAST(e1.emp_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e2 ON r.operator_code = e2.emp_code WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.receive_no, r.apply_emp_id, r.dept_id, r.receive_date, r.receive_reason, r.create_time, r.operator_code, r.update_time, COALESCE(e1.emp_name, '') AS apply_emp_name, COALESCE(e1.emp_code, '') AS apply_emp_code, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '') AS dept_name, COALESCE(e2.emp_name, '') AS operator_name FROM asset_receive_main r LEFT JOIN sys_emp e1 ON r.apply_emp_id = CAST(e1.emp_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e2 ON r.operator_code = e2.emp_code WHERE r.receive_no = #{receiveNo}
SELECT MAX(receive_no) FROM asset_receive_main WHERE receive_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_receive_main (receive_no, apply_emp_id, dept_id, receive_date, receive_reason, operator_code) VALUES (#{receiveNo}, #{applyEmpId}, #{deptId}, #{receiveDate}, #{receiveReason}, #{operatorCode})
